title: How One Refused Snooze Button Trains a Godly Man to Run His Whole Day
caption:
A godly man's whole day gets decided in the first ten seconds he's awake. Before his feet hit the floor, something already voted.

The snooze button isn't about sleep. It's the first vote of the day, and every time you hit it you're telling your body it runs the schedule, not you.

Move before you feel ready. Feeling ready is a myth you've been waiting on for years. Let the first win be small, one refusal repeated, not a perfect morning. Then hand God the first minute before the phone gets it. Psalm 5:3: in the morning He hears your voice, and in the morning you lay your requests before Him.

Win the first ten seconds and the rest of the day gets easier to run.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
